name: Tiree Campsite (Balinoe)
stayType: Campsite with pods, bothy and a cottage
accommodation: Camping pitches, pods and a bothy, plus Skerry View, a self-catering cottage next to the site available all year
suitableFor: Campers, couples and families; dog owners
dogs: Welcome if kept under control and owners clean up after them
beachAccess: The nearest of Tiree's well-known beaches is about a ten-minute walk; Balevullin is a drive across the island
confirmedFeatures: Indoor facilities block with toilets and showers, pods, bothy, adjoining self-catering cottage; open 1 April to 31 October
overview: Tiree Campsite is in the township of Balinoe in the south-west of Tiree, looking towards Mull and the Treshnish Isles. It has pitches, pods and a bothy with an indoor toilet and shower block, and a neighbouring cottage, Skerry View, is let all year. The campsite opens from April to October.
surfTripFit: It is a short drive across this small island to Balevullin, and the mix of pitches, pods and a cottage gives options for different budgets and group sizes.
